name: GOSTOSAS POOL PARTY PRIDE 2026
description: Celebrate Pride Month with a vibrant, inclusive pool party featuring DJs and a fantastic atmosphere.
longDescription:
The GOSTOSAS POOL PARTY PRIDE 2026 is a dedicated event marking Pride Month, offering a celebratory gathering in Porto. This pool party format provides a social setting for attendees to connect and enjoy the occasion. The event is part of the broader Pride celebrations, focusing on community and festivity during June.

Attendees can expect an atmosphere centered around music from DJs and a general sense of enjoyment. The event is designed to be an inclusive space for the LGBTQ+ community and its allies. As a pool party, it offers a relaxed yet energetic environment, suitable for socializing and dancing. The specific character of the venue will be determined once the location is announced.

This is a ticketed event, with details on purchase availability to be released closer to the date. The venue is currently TBC, so specific transport information is not yet available. Further details regarding accessibility will also be provided once the venue is confirmed.

Como festa na piscina, oferece um ambiente descontraído, mas energético, adequado para socializar e dançar. O caráter específico do local será determinado assim que a localização for anunciada.
